description: We are a team of passionate innovators interested in space technology, AI/ML, IoT, Embedded Systems, and scientific problem-solving. Our team brings experience in Python, C++, data analysis, computer vision, and hardware-software integration. We aim to develop innovative, practical solutions to real-world challenges using NASA's open data. We welcome enthusiastic members with skills in programming, astronomy, data science, UI/UX, GIS, research, and creative problem-solving.
